faq.q: Does SnapStats publish downtown Vancouver market statistics?
faq.a: No — Vancouver is not covered in the SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report, whose 14 communities do not include Vancouver, so this research states no Downtown VW median, sales ratio or trend figure, as of September 2026 (checked against subarea-stats-sep2026.csv, community-stats-sep2026.csv, community-trend-sep2026.csv, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: When are property taxes due on a downtown Vancouver condo?
faq.a: To the City of Vancouver: advance taxes were due February 3, 2026 and main taxes were due July 3, 2026, with a 5% penalty on unpaid balances after each due date, and every owner must also file the annual Empty Homes Tax property status declaration (due February 3, 2026).

faq.q: What should I read before buying a condo in Downtown Vancouver?
faq.a: The Form B, the bylaws, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show planned repairs, special levies and rules on pets and rentals.

faq.q: What do strata fees cover on a condo in Downtown Vancouver?
faq.a: Strata fees pay for upkeep and insurance of the common property and the contingency reserve fund, and in some buildings heat, hot water or other services. The Form B Information Certificate lists exactly what a unit's fee covers.
